g.text: 24.5 Dispute assistant: free alerts, paid only on wins
the fee is charged only when money comes back, with a floor for small tickets
paid: success fee on won disputes
minimum per dispute for small tickets
(model cost + human QA) per contested dispute
< fee x win rate x average disputed amount
break-even win rate: 15% on Rs 500, 76% on Rs 100
so low-win reason codes are not auto-contested
the merchant pays only when money comes back: fee follows the outcome
